comment: Claude Code Router Integration Settings for Setas de la Peña
comment2: Copy relevant sections to .claude/settings.json after customizing

modelRouting.description: Route all Claude Code requests through CCR for cost optimization and provider switching

tracking.description: Monitor token usage and estimated costs across all sessions

modelDefaults.description: Default models for task types; CCR routing rules can override

routingRules.name: Fallback to OpenAI on Anthropic failure

analytics.description: Cost and usage analytics in CCR UI

environment.description: Automatically route Anthropic SDK calls through CCR

setup_checklist: Install CCR desktop app or CLI
Add Anthropic API key in CCR Providers
Check CCR Logs to verify routing
cost_optimization_tips: Use Haiku for simple queries (<1500 tokens) to save 90% vs Opus
Use Sonnet for complex reasoning where Haiku struggles
Batch related queries to reduce overhead
Review CCR Analytics monthly to find overused models
Set costWarningThreshold to catch unexpected spikes

troubleshooting.no_provider_response: Check CCR Server tab is Running, and Providers tab has valid API keys
troubleshooting.higher_than_expected_cost: Review Analytics; check if Opus is being used for simple tasks
troubleshooting.slow_responses: Check CCR Logs latency; consider closer provider or model
troubleshooting.routing_not_working: Verify ANTHROPIC_API_ENDPOINT env var is set; restart Claude Code session
